queries.rawSql:
select id || '-' || name as f, 
			 name, id,
			 cast(id as varchar) as   "span_attributes.h", cast(id as varchar) as  host, operational_status,
			 administrative_status , 
			(location->>'latitude')::float + (random()/10000)  AS latitude, 
			(location->>'longitude')::float  + (random()/10000) AS longitude
from site s 
where device is not null 
order by name
